in_hebrew.name: קטרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בעברית, שם זה נשבע לתפקיד חזק ואומן, ובאפשרות, רגש שקט ושלווה, שנבע מהאל, וסמל לגבורה וליפי. במסורת הנוצרית, קטרינה מיוחסת לאזור הבשורה, והוא נחשב לשם מפלא בכנסייה. גם ביהדות, קטרינה (קטרינה) היא שם נשים, שניתן לה ככבוד, ואף נחשב לשם מקודש.

in_latin.name: Catharina
in_latin.long_meaning: בלטינית, שם זה (Catharina) נשבע לתפקיד חזק ואומן, ובאפשרות, רגש שקט ושלווה, שנבע מהאל, וסמל לגבורה וליפי. שם זה נשבע לפאטרונס, (patroness), של ספרד, ומתפקד כשם חג, (festival name), בכנסייה הקתולית.

in_english.name: Katarina
in_english.meaning: Strong, pure, gentle, and peaceful, a feminine name of great strength and beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Katarina is of Greek origin, derived from the name Aikaterine, which means 'pure.' It is also associated with the Latin name Catharina, which was popularized by Saint Catherine of Alexandria. In Christianity, Saint Catherine is revered as a patron saint of students, philosophers, and wheelwrights. The name Katarina has been a popular choice for Christian parents, symbolizing the qualities of strength, purity, and gentleness. It is also a common name in many European countries, including Spain, Germany, and Sweden. In modern times, the name Katarina has become a trendy choice for parents looking for a unique and meaningful name with rich cultural and historical significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Katarina has been carried across centuries and continents, with various adaptations in different languages. In Eastern Europe, the name is common in Croatia, Russia, Serbia, Bulgaria, and Romania. In other parts of the world, it is known as Catherine, Katerina, Kathe, or Hannah. The name carries a rich cultural history that encompasses art, literature, music, and reverence towards the Catholic and Orthodox Saints. Many churches, cathedrals, and artworks are dedicated to Saint Catherine, adding to the immense influence of the name. The name Katarina is loved for its unique and classic sound, smooth flow, and the beautiful stories it carries.
data.spiritual_significance: Katarina is a name that holds a deep spiritual meaning rooted in ideal perfection, purity, and clarity. For Christians, the name is often associated with Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a pioneering figure in the early Christian Church who faced persecution for her faith and was later martyred. Her story is one of adversity, courage, and unwavering devotion to God. The name Katarina serves as a constant reminder of the importance of purity of the soul and body, living a life that is clear and untainted by worldly desires, and striving for spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name embodies a deep connection to the divine and inspires a sense of reverence and respect among those who bear it.
